list: the official 55 trophies, verified 19 Nov 2026 against Exophase and PSNProfiles (55/55 names, descriptions and grades agree; 28 hidden, 0 online)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn, because PlayStation only awards it once the other 54 are all yours. There is no shortcut, no difficulty setting to game and no single trick that unlocks it early: the platinum is the sum of everything below, from the opening mission Gone Fishing to the 100% completion checklist. Plan for the long haul rather than a sprint. The launch-day guides put the platinum at around 200 hours, and almost all of that time sits in the grind trophies — 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicle models, all 39 illegal operations — rather than in the story, which is the easy half of the list. Work through the roadmap in this guide in order: story first, side stories second, crime and activities third, money and the odd moments fourth, and the 100% checklist last, because most of the grind fills itself in while you play the rest. Keep one rule for the whole run: never use cheats on your trophy save, since cheats are reported to switch off trophies and saving, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, because there is no mission replay to fall back on. When the final trophy pops, this one pops with it — that is the moment the whole list is done.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Platinum rule and ~200-hour estimate: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and finish it. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first story trophy most players will earn, and it cannot be missed — just play the story from the start and the trophy pops when the mission ends. There is no preparation, no side requirement and no choice to get wrong: the mission introduces you to Leonida and to the two leads, and completing it is simply a matter of following the on-screen objectives through to the end. If you are trophy hunting from the first minute, use this mission to get comfortable with the basics — driving, the map, the way objectives appear — because every later story trophy works the same way: finish the named mission and the trophy follows. One practical tip for the whole run: start a manual save habit now, at the start of each chapter, since there is no mission replay later. But for this trophy itself there is nothing to plan, nothing to buy and nothing to grind; it is the gentle start of the story, and it is also the moment the tracker in this guide starts counting.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Opening mission: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops as the chapter closes — note that chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it is a few seconds late. Chapter 1 is the shortest chapter and the one place in the whole game where a trophy can be missed, so treat it with more care than the later chapters. Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation: after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time), follow her out to the balcony of Jason's house and accept the optional meditation task. It counts toward Positive Mental Attitude, it disappears once Chapter 1 ends, and it is not confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it — so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until Positive Mental Attitude pops. Also use Chapter 1 to beat Cal in a fishing challenge and finish an arcade game if the chance comes up, since both are easy early trophies. Otherwise just play the chapter through: no mission in it needs a special approach, and the trophy is unmissable as long as you finish the chapter.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Chapter 1 balcony meditation warning and chapter-trophy timing: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026 (strict-need question unconfirmed).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy pops as the chapter closes (chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter instead, so give it a moment). Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: switching between Jason and Lucia unlocks right after the mission Breakfast Run, and from then on you can switch characters and call the other one in as your partner — and several trophies need the two of them together, so get used to switching early. Two things in this chapter are worth doing while you are here rather than later. First, the Vice City Real Estate app unlocks after the mission Daily Driver, which is what lets you buy the eight garages for Little Boxes; and the mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app, which is what lets you register vehicles for On the Spot. Second, the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling — is an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2, and robbing it properly (Sticky Bombs, all three key valuables) is the way to Let's Go Bowling. None of that is required for this chapter trophy itself: finish the chapter and it pops. But doing those unlocks now means the money and exploration trophies start counting sooner.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Character switching after Breakfast Run, garage app after Daily Driver, Scooter Bros after Moses, Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3 and the trophy pops as the chapter closes (chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter instead). Chapter 3 is the busiest chapter for trophy hunters, because several tools and trophies arrive here at once, so slow down a little and do the chapter's one-off jobs while they are in front of you. The mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies — that is the key to Sneakthief, and you should use the Snap Gun on a store's locked back door rather than kicking it in, which sets off the alarm. Race Against Yago, in Yago's street racing strand, is time-sensitive: it carries an hourglass icon, so save first and race the moment it appears, because the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray for On the Spot. And with both characters playable, this is a good chapter to start the partner trophies — robbing three shops back-to-back with your partner for Retail Therapy, and losing a 4-star wanted level together for Hot Together. None of those are needed for this trophy itself, but Chapter 3 is where they first become possible, and doing them now saves backtracking later.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Yago race time-sensitive in Chapter 3, Pay 'n' Spray registration from Chapter 3: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4 and the trophy pops as the chapter closes (chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter instead). Chapter 4 is where the robbery trophies come together, so before you rush to the finale, make sure you have done the chapter's optional robbery mission, That's Where The Money Is, near the end of the chapter. That mission unlocks bank vaults: you tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open, and you cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Vault jobs give you a 4-star wanted level straight away, which is why escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together — and the trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. The same chapter is also your window for the armored truck robbery and for the last of the story missions tied to this chapter's trophies. As with every chapter, keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 4, and keep one untouched save from just before the final mission, because there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus at launch. Finish the chapter, and this trophy is yours.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Bank vaults through That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4; vault escape and heat zone: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story and this gold trophy pops. It is unmissable as long as you finish the story, and it is the second of the two gold trophies — the other is A Long Road, for 100% completion. Before you start the final mission, do three things. First, make an untouched manual save from just before it and do not overwrite it: there is no mission replay, so that save is your only way back if you want to redo anything in the finale or check a choice afterwards. Second, finish anything story-gated that you have been putting off, especially the Chapter 3 Yago race and the Chapter 1 balcony meditation if you have not already done them, because the story will not wait for you. Third, remember that everything outside the story stays available after the credits — the side-story finales, the 100% checklist, the free-roam grind — so the final mission is not a deadline for the rest of the list, it is the door into the long cleanup phase. Play the finale, watch the credits, and then use the roadmap in this guide to work through what is left, starting with the side stories.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Save before the final mission, no mission replay, post-story availability: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run and the trophy pops when it ends. This is one of the early story missions, and it matters for more than its own trophy: switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run, in Chapter 2, and from then on you can switch characters and call the other one in as your partner. That unlock is the key to the partner trophies — Hot Together and Retail Therapy both need your partner with you, and several other trophies are much easier with two characters working together. So when Breakfast Run is done, take a minute to learn the switch: try swapping characters, try calling your partner in, and get comfortable with having both of them in play before you move on. The mission itself needs no special preparation and cannot be missed: play the story in order, finish Breakfast Run, and the trophy follows. If you are tracking your run in this guide, tick this one off and check the roadmap — Stage 1 is the story, and this mission is the point where the story stops being a single-character game.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Character switching opens after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist and the trophy pops when it ends. Like every named-mission trophy, it cannot be missed: play the story in order, finish the mission, and the trophy follows, with no side requirement and no choice that can lock it out. Heist missions are usually the longest and most involved missions in a chapter, so go into this one with your gear in order — a full set of weapons, some armour if you have it, and a vehicle you are comfortable driving — and do not be surprised if it takes a couple of attempts on the harder stretches. If a section keeps beating you, slow down rather than rushing it: use cover, let your partner draw fire, and remember that there is no mission replay, so a failed attempt just restarts the mission, it does not cost you the trophy. The Cartel Heist is also a good mission to play with the money trophies in mind: heist payouts feed the spending and laundering totals, so the cash you earn here counts toward Treat Yo Self and Dime on the Dollar later. Finish the heist, tick the trophy off, and move on to the next story mission.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Mission trophies pop on completion, no mission replay: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play and the trophy pops when it ends. It is a named-mission trophy, so it cannot be missed: play the story in order and finish the mission. Missions with a name like this one are the backbone of the story trophies — twelve of them, from Gone Fishing to the final mission, make up Stage 1 of the roadmap — and the only thing that can go wrong with them is not playing them at all. Treat each one as a checkpoint: when it pops, tick it off in this guide and check what the next story mission unlocks, because missions often open new systems (a new app, a new robbery type, a new area) that feed the non-story trophies. Child's Play is no exception in that sense, even though the trophy itself asks for nothing beyond completion. If you are playing with the spoiler setting on, this trophy stays hidden until you earn it, which is exactly how PlayStation treats it: it is one of the 28 hidden trophies. Finish the mission, let the trophy reveal itself, and keep moving through the story.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Story mission trophies: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners and the trophy pops when it ends. Named-mission trophies like this one are unmissable: play the story in order, finish Headliners, and the trophy follows. There is no hidden requirement, no collectible to grab inside the mission and no dialogue choice that changes the outcome for trophy purposes. The practical advice is the same as for every story mission in this guide: keep a manual save at the start of the chapter you are in, because there is no mission replay, and do not test cheats on your trophy save, since cheats are reported to switch off trophies and saving. If a mission is giving you trouble, the fix is usually to slow down, use cover, and let the mission's checkpoints do their work — failing a mission just restarts it, it never locks the trophy away. Headliners sits in the middle of the story's run of named missions, so when it pops you are well into Stage 1 of the roadmap; check the tracker to see how many of the twelve story trophies you have left, and keep playing.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Mission trophies pop on completion, no mission replay: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown and the trophy pops when it ends. VCIA is Vice City International Airport, and this mission is your introduction to the airport as a place — which matters, because the airport is also the setting for one of the trickiest free-roam trophies, Catch Me If You Can. That trophy needs you to steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge (the planes at gates E3 and E4 work), back out toward the runway, take off, and fly about 1 km away from the airport before it pops — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count, and the police come fast, so save first. You do not need to do any of that during VCIA Takedown itself: the mission trophy only asks you to finish the mission. But once you have played the mission you will know the airport's layout, the gates and the runways, and that knowledge makes the later plane theft much easier. Finish the mission, tick the trophy off, and remember the airport for later — it is one of the few places in Leonida where a trophy depends on exactly where you stand.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. VCIA plane method (gates E3/E4, fly ~1 km): OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory and the trophy pops when it ends. It is the last of the named-mission trophies in the story run, and like the others it cannot be missed: play the story in order, finish the mission, and the trophy follows. By the time you reach it you will have most of Stage 1 done — the four chapter trophies, the final mission still to come, and the named missions in between — so use this point in the game to take stock. Check the tracker: how many story trophies are left, and have you done the chapter-specific jobs that do not wait, like the Chapter 1 balcony meditation and the Chapter 3 Yago race? If either is still undone and its chapter is still open, do it now; if its chapter has closed, your manual save from the start of that chapter is your way back. Operation Savage Glory itself needs no special approach beyond the usual mission advice — cover, patience, and no cheats on your trophy save. Finish it, and the story's final stretch is in front of you.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Mission trophies pop on completion; chapter-save advice: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion and this gold trophy pops — it is the second gold trophy, and the hardest trophy on the list, because it is a checklist of almost everything else in the game rather than a single task. The checklist itself only appears after the story, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, but work you do earlier still counts, so do not wait for it to appear before you start: every stunt, every challenge, every vehicle you discover along the way is already banking progress. The numbers the launch-day guide reports for the checklist are steep: 300 stunts (more than the 250 Cunning Stunts needs), 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 base vehicle models, all 39 illegal operations, all eight bank vaults, and the rest of the story, side-story and activity totals. That is why the platinum takes around 200 hours, and why this trophy is Stage 6, the last stage of the roadmap: play the story, finish the side stories, do the crime and activity trophies, and let the checklist fill in as you go, then use the post-story cleanup to close the gaps the checklist shows you. Check the checklist the moment it appears and work down its remaining lines one at a time, cheapest first, so the last few percent are the ones you enjoy rather than the ones you dread.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/100. Checklist appears after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion; 300 stunts, 70/80 Challenges, 200/277 vehicles, 39 operations, 8 vaults: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts and this silver trophy pops. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, so you are not locked into one kind of stunt: use whatever you are good at, and mix them up when one type gets stale. The practical way to do it is to fold stunts into everything else you do rather than grinding all 250 in one sitting — jump a ramp on the way to a mission, fly under a bridge on the way across the map, base-jump off a tall building when you are passing one. Stunts are free-roam, so you can grind them anywhere after the story, and they never expire. But do not stop at 250: the 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going past this trophy's target and the extra 50 will already be banked for A Long Road. Track your count in this guide's counter (PlayStation tracks 0/250) and in the game's own stats, and if you want the grind to go faster, pick a fast vehicle or a stunt plane and a route with several stunt spots in a row, then loop it. This is a long trophy, not a hard one — a little at a time, every session, beats a single miserable marathon.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/250. Stunt types and 300 for 100%: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once and this bronze trophy pops. PlayStation tracks it as 0/9, so you can see exactly how many types you have tried and how many are left. The trick is knowing what counts as a type: the game's activities include things like fishing, the shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, gym training, meditation and racing, and the trophy only needs one try of each — you do not need to win, finish or master any of them, just try them. That makes it one of the cheapest trophies on the list if you plan it: in a single free-roam session, work down the activity list, try one of each, and tick them off in this guide as you go. If you are stuck on the last one or two, check which activities you have already done for their own trophies — Baited My Tackle (fishing), The Shootist (shooting range), Top Fun (drone racing), Stick Fiddler (arcade) and Let's Go Bowling (bowling) each cover a type, so the remaining ones are the activities with no trophy of their own. Nothing here is missable and nothing needs a chapter: every activity stays available after the credits, so you can finish this trophy at any point in the game.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/9. Activity examples from the launch-day guide: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges and this silver trophy pops. There should be two shooting ranges with 42 gold medals between them, so the work is spread across two locations rather than one long list in a single place. This is a skill trophy, not a grind trophy: each challenge has a gold-medal score or time to beat, and the way to earn it is to learn the challenge, not to repeat it blindly. Go in with the right weapon for the challenge, take the first run slowly to learn the target layout, then push for speed and accuracy on the next runs — and remember that Combat Focus, the slow-motion aim you use for Gunslinger, is a tool here too, since it steadies your aim when the targets are moving fast. PlayStation tracks it as 0/42, so you can see which challenges are still missing gold and go back to just those, rather than replaying the ones you have already golded. Nothing here is missable and the ranges stay open after the story, so there is no rush: do a few challenges per session, gold the easy ones first to build confidence, and save the hardest ones for when your aim and your weapon handling are at their best.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/42. Two ranges, 42 medals between them: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations and this bronze trophy pops. PlayStation tracks it as 0/14, so you can see how many locations you have won at and which ones are left. A drone race is a flying race through checkpoints, and the skill is in the flying rather than in the drone itself: learn the course on your first run at a new location, then race it properly on the second, cutting corners where the checkpoints allow and keeping your speed up through the turns. You only need one win at each location, not a win at every race at that location, so once a location is ticked off, move on to the next one rather than replaying it. The 14 locations are spread across Leonida, so this trophy doubles as a tour of the map — and if you are also working on The Goodtime State, which needs you to explore all 52 areas, the drone race locations are a good excuse to visit places you have not been yet. Nothing here is missable and the races stay available after the credits, so take them one location at a time, a few per session, and let the wins accumulate.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/14. Win at least one race at each location: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races and this bronze trophy pops. The word that matters is different: winning the same race twenty times does not count, so you need twenty distinct races, and PlayStation tracks it as 0/20. Races in Leonida come in several forms — street races, off-road races, and the races in Yago's street racing strand, among others — and the practical approach is to try a new race every time you see one, rather than replaying a favourite. The Yago strand deserves special attention: its race, Race Against Yago, is time-sensitive in Chapter 3 (it carries an hourglass icon), so save first and race the moment it appears, because that strand also counts toward Strangers & Freaks. For the other nineteen, pick races that suit the vehicle you have: a fast road car for street races, something tougher for off-road, and do not be afraid to retry a race a few times — a loss does not cost you anything except time, and learning the course is half the win. Nothing here is missable except the Yago timing, and races stay available after the credits, so work through the list at your own pace and tick each new win off in this guide.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/20. Yago race time-sensitive in Chapter 3: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge and this bronze trophy pops. Fishing is one of the game's activities, and Cal is the rival you face in a fishing challenge — the trophy is about winning that head-to-head, not about catching a particular fish or reaching a particular size. Go into the challenge with the basics in mind: fishing is a timing activity, so watch the line, wait for the bite, and reel steadily rather than yanking, and if the challenge has rounds or a score, play the early rounds carefully so you are not chasing the score at the end. If you lose, just try again: a lost fishing challenge costs nothing and does not lock the trophy away, and each attempt teaches you the rhythm of the challenge. This is also a good early trophy, because fishing is available from early in the game and the opening mission Gone Fishing introduces you to it — the launch-day checklist even suggests beating Cal in Chapter 1 if the chance comes up. It counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so tick both off when it pops. Nothing here is missable, and fishing stays available after the credits.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Fishing challenge against Cal; suggested in Chapter 1: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game and this bronze trophy pops. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts, so you do not need to find a particular machine or beat a particular high score — pick the game you enjoy most, or the one you find easiest, and play it through to the end. Arcade games are short, self-contained activities, which makes this one of the quickest trophies on the list: find an arcade machine, start a game, and finish it. If the first game you try is harder than it looks, switch to another of the four rather than grinding at the one that is beating you — the trophy only asks for one completion, not a completion of all four. It also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so it pulls double duty with the other activity trophies. The launch-day checklist suggests finishing an arcade game in Chapter 1 if the chance comes up, but there is no deadline: arcade games stay available after the credits, and nothing about this trophy can be missed. Do it early for a quick win, or save it for a quiet moment between missions.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Any of the four in-game games counts: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy and this bronze trophy pops. Andy is one of the side-story characters — the people whose questlines end in a trophy of their own — and his questline is Lucia-only, so you will be playing it as Lucia. Side-story finales like this one stay available after the credits, so there is no deadline and nothing to rush: work through Andy's missions as they appear, and when the final one arrives, finish it and the trophy follows. The important thing to know about Andy's questline, and about all six side-story finales, is that they do not count toward Strangers & Freaks: only some optional questlines count for that trophy, and Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. So do not expect Andy's finale to move the Strangers & Freaks counter — it has its own reward, and this trophy is it. Play the questline in order, do the final mission, and tick it off. If you are working through Stage 2 of the roadmap, Andy is one of seven side-story trophies to collect, alongside Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and the eight stranger strands.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Andy's questline is Lucia-only; Andy, Billy and Tyrone do not count toward Strangers & Freaks: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton and this bronze trophy pops. Kenton is one of the side-story characters whose questline ends in a trophy of its own, and like the other side-story finales, it stays available after the credits — so there is no deadline, no chapter to beat, and nothing that can be missed. Work through Kenton's missions as they appear, and when the final mission arrives, finish it and the trophy follows. Side-story questlines are the heart of Stage 2 of the roadmap: seven trophies, one for each of Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, plus the eight stranger strands of Strangers & Freaks. Kenton's is a straightforward finale — the trophy asks for the final mission and nothing else — so the only mistake you can make is leaving it undone and forgetting about it in the post-story cleanup. Use this guide's tracker to keep it visible: leave it unticked until it pops, and when you are working through the side stories after the credits, take them one character at a time, Kenton included, until all seven are done.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Side-story finales stay open after the story: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy and this bronze trophy pops. Billy is one of the side-story characters, and his questline ends in this trophy — a finale that stays available after the credits, so there is no deadline and nothing that can be missed. Play Billy's missions as they appear, and when the final one arrives, finish it. One detail worth knowing: Billy's questline does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy, just like Andy's and Tyrone's. That matters when you are counting stranger strands for the silver trophy, because it is easy to assume every side questline counts and then wonder why the counter has not moved. The rule the launch-day guide gives is to check the Strangers & Freaks progress counter after each strand you finish, so you can see which ones actually count. For Billy himself, the rule is simpler: his finale is its own trophy, it stays open after the story, and finishing it is the whole job. Do it as part of Stage 2, alongside the other five side-story finales, and tick it off when it pops.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Billy's questline does not count toward Strangers & Freaks; side-story finales stay open after the story: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida and this silver trophy pops. PlayStation tracks it as 0/8, so you can see how many strands you have finished. The catch is that only some optional questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies, so you need eight strands from the other strangers you meet across the state. The practical method is to check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish — if it moved, that strand counted; if it did not, it was one of the ones with its own trophy. Work through stranger encounters as you find them in free roam and in the story, and do not leave them all for the end: one strand is time-sensitive, and that is the one that makes this trophy at-risk rather than safe. Race Against Yago, in Yago's street racing strand in Chapter 3, carries an hourglass icon — save first, then race the moment it appears, because if that strand is one of your eight and you miss its window, the count gets harder. Everything else about this trophy is forgiving: the strands stay available after the credits, and the counter tells you exactly where you stand.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/8. Andy, Billy and Tyrone do not count; check the counter after each strand; Yago race time-sensitive in Chapter 3: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy and this bronze trophy pops. Randy is one of the side-story characters whose questline ends in a trophy of its own, and his finale stays available after the credits, so there is no deadline and nothing that can be missed. Work through Randy's missions as they appear, and when the final one arrives, finish it and the trophy follows. Randy's questline is one of the seven side-story trophies in Stage 2 of the roadmap, alongside Andy, Kenton, Billy, Tyrone, Bret and the eight stranger strands. Unlike Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's questlines, the launch-day guide does not single Randy's out as excluded from Strangers & Freaks, so the safest approach is the one it recommends for every strand: check the Strangers & Freaks progress counter after you finish a Randy mission strand, and let the counter tell you whether it counted. For this trophy itself, though, the rule is simple and does not depend on that question: finish Randy's final mission, and Supply & Demand is yours. Do the side stories one character at a time after the story, and do not leave Randy for last just because his name is easy to forget.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Side-story finales stay open after the story; check the Strangers & Freaks counter after each strand: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone and this bronze trophy pops. Tyrone is one of the side-story characters, and his questline is Jason-only, so you will be playing it as Jason — the mirror of Andy's questline, which is Lucia-only. His finale stays available after the credits, so there is no deadline and nothing that can be missed: work through Tyrone's missions as they appear, and when the final one arrives, finish it. Like Andy's and Billy's, Tyrone's questline does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy — so do not expect the silver trophy's counter to move when Tyrone's finale pops, and do not count Tyrone among your eight stranger strands. That is the only trap in this trophy, and it is a counting trap rather than a gameplay one. Play the questline in order, switch to Jason when Tyrone's missions need him, finish the final mission, and tick this trophy off as part of Stage 2. With Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret done, plus the eight stranger strands, Stage 2 is complete.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and does not count toward Strangers & Freaks; side-story finales stay open after the story: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida and this bronze trophy pops — and this is the one trophy on the whole list that can truly be missed, so read this guide carefully before you finish Chapter 1. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time: switch to the other character, call them in, and meditate together to get the most out of each spot. The missable one is Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1. After Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time): she heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate, and if you follow her and accept the optional task, it counts. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends. It is not confirmed that Positive Mental Attitude strictly needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops — that save is your insurance. PlayStation tracks it as 0/18, so you can see how many spots are left, and the other 17 spots stay available after the credits. Do the balcony one first, then work through the rest at your leisure.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/18. Purple icons, partner counting twice, Chapter 1 balcony meditation (strict-need unconfirmed): OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret and this bronze trophy pops. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only, so you will be playing it as Jason, and it sends you after animals through target decks — a series of hunting targets rather than a single free-roam hunt. The launch-day advice is to aim for a clean head or heart shot, because a clean shot keeps the carcass pristine, and a pristine carcass is what a hunting questline like this one is usually judging. Take your time on each target: spot the animal, line up the shot, and do not rush it, because a messy shot can mean a wasted target. Hunting is a slower activity than the rest of the game, and that is the point — it is a change of pace from the driving and shooting of the main story, and it rewards patience over speed. The questline stays available after the credits, so there is no deadline and nothing that can be missed: work through Bret's targets one at a time, keep your shots clean, and when the unique animal is hunted, the trophy pops. It is the seventh and last of the side-story trophies in Stage 2.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Bret's questline is Jason-only, target decks, clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets and this silver trophy pops. PlayStation tracks it as 0/3, so you can see how many sets you have finished. Collectible cards are scattered across Leonida, and a set is complete when you have every card in it — so the work is in two parts: finding the cards, and knowing which set each card belongs to, so you can tell which sets are close to complete and which ones still need a long search. The practical approach is to collect as you travel rather than hunting cards in one dedicated sweep: pick up cards whenever you pass them, check your sets after each session, and when a set is one card short, go looking for that specific card rather than wandering. Cards are a free-roam collectible, so they stay available after the credits and nothing about them can be missed — you can finish this trophy at any point, and you can finish it entirely after the story if you prefer. It pairs naturally with the other exploration trophies: while you are out collecting cards, you are also discovering vehicles for Whip It Good, exploring areas for The Goodtime State, and finding WAiNK It locations for You WAiNKer!, so one trip can move four trophies at once.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/3. Collectible cards across Leonida: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026 (card locations not pinned down by a source — no specific location is claimed here).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations and this silver trophy pops. WAiNK is the in-game app you use to scan and tag locations, and the trophy is a pure count: one hundred distinct locations, tracked by PlayStation as 0/100. The way to do it is to make WAiNK a habit rather than a grind — scan a location every time you arrive somewhere new, and the count will climb while you do everything else. It pairs with the other discovery trophies in the most useful way: scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app also counts as discovering it for Whip It Good, so scanning traffic as you drive moves both trophies at once, and the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base vehicle models, so the habit pays off three times over. If you reach the late game and the count has stalled, the fix is to go somewhere you have not been: new neighbourhoods, new landmarks, new stretches of road, because a location you have already tagged does not count twice. Nothing here is missable and every location stays available after the credits, so this is a long, gentle trophy — a hundred small actions, done whenever you are passing through, rather than a single session of work.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/100. Scanning a vehicle with WAiNK counts as discovering it; 100% needs 200/277 models: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges and this bronze trophy pops. Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges, and PlayStation tracks this trophy as 0/50 — so the first thing to do is open that list and see what you have already done without trying, because many Challenges complete on their own while you play. The list covers the game's systems broadly — driving, combat, exploration, activities — which means the fastest way to 50 is to play widely rather than deeply: try a bit of everything, and the Challenges will tick off as a side effect. But do not stop at 50: the 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80 Challenges, so the extra 20 are already on your road to A Long Road, and the checklist is the reason to keep the Challenges list open while you play the post-story cleanup. If you stall in the high 40s, read the list line by line and pick the cheapest remaining ones — a short drive, a single stunt, a quick activity — rather than the longest grinds, and save the grinds for the 100% run. Nothing here is missable and Challenges stay available after the credits, so this is a trophy that rewards looking at the list, not just playing blind.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/50. Challenges under Progress > Challenges; 100% needs 70 of 80, many complete on their own: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat, and this bronze trophy pops. The key words are with your partner and escape the heat: you need Jason and Lucia together, a 4-star wanted level, and a clean escape — and the trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area, so do not stop running the moment the stars start to fade. The easiest way to earn it is alongside Maximum Withdrawal: bank vault jobs give you a 4-star wanted level straight away, so escaping a vault job with your partner earns both trophies in one run. To set it up, call your partner in before you start the crime, get to 4 stars, and then escape properly — break line of sight, get out of the red heat zone on the map, and keep moving until the wanted level clears. A fast car and a route away from the city centre help, and so does knowing the map: the heat zone is the area the police are searching, and leaving it is the actual requirement, not just hiding for a few seconds. If the escape fails, try again — a failed escape costs nothing, and the next attempt is a fresh chance. Nothing here is missable.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Partner needed; pops only after leaving the red heat zone; vault jobs give 4 stars at once: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level, and this bronze trophy pops. The chain is the whole trophy: call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks — so the trick is to keep the wanted level alive between shops, moving fast from one shop to the next without giving the police time to lose you. Pick three shops close together before you start, so the run between them is short, and plan the route in advance: rob the first, get out, drive straight to the second, rob it, and then straight to the third. Your partner needs to be with you for all three, so call them in before the first robbery and keep them close. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before you hit a fourth shop or do anything else — it is a delayed pop, not a failed attempt. If the chain breaks, it costs nothing: set it up again with three fresh shops and go again. Nothing here is missable, and shops stay robbable after the credits.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Call your partner first; chain breaks if the stars fade; ~30-second delay after the third shop: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles and this bronze trophy pops. PlayStation tracks it as 0/100, and the way discovery works is the WAiNK app: scanning a vehicle with WAiNK counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive and the count will climb without a dedicated grind. That is the single most useful fact about this trophy, because it turns every drive into progress — a new model in traffic is a new discovery, and a model you have already scanned does not count twice, so variety is what matters. Do not stop at 100: the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base vehicle models, so keep scanning past this trophy and the extra hundred will already be banked for A Long Road. If the count stalls, go somewhere with different traffic — a different neighbourhood, a different time of day, a highway instead of a side street — because the vehicles you have not seen yet are the ones in places you have not driven. Nothing here is missable and every vehicle stays available after the credits, so this is a long, gentle trophy that rewards looking around while you drive, not a checklist to finish in one sitting.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/100. Scanning a vehicle with WAiNK counts as discovering it; 100% needs 200/277 models: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus and this bronze trophy pops. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming, and time slows so you can line up shots that would be hard at full speed. The trophy needs five takedowns inside one single use, so the setup matters more than the shooting: pick a group of enemies standing close together, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and start Combat Focus when they are all in view, so you can work through them one after another before the focus runs out. An assault rifle is a good choice, because it lets you switch targets fast without reloading mid-focus, and Adrenaline extends Focus, so use it if you have it and the group is spread out. Do not waste the focus on a single enemy or on a group that is already scattering — wait for a moment when five enemies are grouped and unaware, then trigger it and take them down in order. If you only get three or four, it costs nothing: find another group, set it up again, and go again. Nothing here is missable, and illegal operations stay available after the credits, so there are plenty of groups to practise on.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Combat Focus is L3+R3 while aiming; gang guards at an illegal operation, assault rifle, Adrenaline extends Focus: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport — and this bronze trophy pops. The method the launch-day guide gives is specific, and the specificity is the whole trophy: steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge, go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. Planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count, so do not waste time on them — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, and those are the ones to look for. Save first, because the police come fast once you are in the plane, and the trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops, so do not expect it the moment the wheels leave the ground. Keep flying straight and level, get clear of the airport, and give it a moment. If the plane is damaged or the police bring you down before the kilometre is up, reload your save and try again with the same gates — the method does not change, only the execution. Nothing here is missable and the airport stays open after the credits, so you can attempt it as many times as you need.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Jet at a boarding bridge, gates E3/E4, fly ~1 km out, trophy delayed, save first: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — a Rhino — and this bronze trophy pops. The description, Kinda hot in these Rhinos, is the hint: Rhinos are the tanks, and the trophy is about getting into one and using it. The launch-day guide reports that tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map — so that is where to look first. Save before you go, because a military base is not a quiet place: getting in, driving and firing until the trophy pops will draw attention, and a save lets you retry without losing progress. Once you are in the tank, drive it and fire it until the trophy pops — the trophy is about being in the Rhino and using it, not about reaching a particular place or destroying a particular target, so do not overthink the objective once you are inside. If there is no tank where you looked, or the base is too hot to get in cleanly, back off, save again, and try a different approach — the location is reported, not guaranteed, and the guide is honest about that. Nothing here is missable, and the air station stays available after the credits.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Tanks reported parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, far southwest island; save first: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026 (location reported, not confirmed).

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected and this bronze trophy pops. The method the launch-day guide gives is a chain of three steps, and skipping any one of them is what ruins the attempt. First, get the Snap Gun: the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives it to you and opens jewelry store robberies, so do not attempt this trophy before that mission. Second, go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm, and the alarm is what ends a stealth attempt. Third, inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target, according to the launch-day guide. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on: a detected robbery cannot become an undetected one, and reloading your save is faster than finishing a failed attempt and setting it up again. Save before you enter, move slowly inside, and leave the way you came. Nothing here is missable, and jewelry stores stay robbable after the credits.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3); back door with Snap Gun, not a kick; note with safe code; Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City; reload if spotted: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, and this silver trophy pops. PlayStation tracks it as 0/5, so you can see how many vaults you have finished. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4, so do not look for vaults before that mission — they are not open yet. The method is to tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open, and you cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner: the vault job is a two-person job, and your partner is also what makes Hot Together possible on the same run, because vault jobs give you a 4-star wanted level straight away. Escaping is half the trophy, and the escape only counts once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area — so after the vault, run properly, break line of sight, get out of the red zone, and keep moving until the wanted level clears. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults, so keep going past the five this trophy needs: the extra three are already banked for A Long Road. Nothing here is missable, and vaults stay available after the credits, so do them one at a time and let the count climb.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/5. Vaults through That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4; tail a van, bring your partner, escape the red heat zone; 100% needs all 8 vaults: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape, and this bronze trophy pops. Armored trucks are the moving targets of Leonida's robbery trophies: they drive set routes, they are guarded, and the robbery is about stopping the truck, getting into it, and getting away clean. The escape is the part that matters for the trophy, just as it is for Maximum Withdrawal — the trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area, so after the robbery, run properly and keep moving until the wanted level clears. Plan the robbery the way you would plan any getaway: pick a truck on a route with a clear escape road nearby, stop it somewhere you can leave fast, and have a fast vehicle ready for the escape rather than relying on the truck itself. If the first attempt goes wrong — the truck gets away, the guards overwhelm you, the escape stalls — it costs nothing: armored trucks keep running their routes, and the next one is a fresh attempt. This trophy pairs with the other robbery trophies in Stage 3, and doing it after you have learned the escape rules from Hot Together and Maximum Withdrawal makes it much easier. Nothing here is missable, and armored trucks stay available after the credits.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Escape only counts after leaving the red heat zone: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026 (armored truck method itself not pinned down by a source — no specific stop or route is claimed here).

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and this bronze trophy pops. PlayStation tracks it as 0/52, because Leonida is divided into 52 areas and the trophy needs all of them visited. The practical way to do it is to let exploration happen while you do everything else: every mission, every side story, every drone race location and every collectible run takes you somewhere new, and the areas tick off as you travel. When the count stalls in the high 40s, open the map and look for the gaps — the corners you have never driven through, the islands you have never visited, the rural stretches between the cities — and drive through them deliberately, one area at a time, until the map is full. It pairs with the other discovery trophies: while you are exploring, scan vehicles with WAiNK for Whip It Good, tag locations for You WAiNKer!, and pick up collectible cards for Don't Touch My Deck, so one exploration trip moves four trophies at once. Nothing here is missable and every area stays available after the credits, so there is no need to rush it: finish the story, finish the side stories, and then take a tour of the state with the map as your checklist.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/52. Explore all 52 areas of Leonida: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs and this bronze trophy pops. PlayStation tracks it as 0/9, so you can see how many gangs you have robbed and which ones are left. Illegal operations are the gang-run businesses scattered across Leonida — the bowling alley, the jewelry stores, the chop shops and the rest — and each one belongs to a gang, so the trophy is about variety, not volume: one operation per gang, nine gangs, nine robberies. The practical approach is to rob an operation whenever you are in a new gang's territory, and to check the counter after each robbery so you can see which gangs are still missing. Do not stop at nine: the 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so keep robbing past this trophy and the extra thirty will already be banked for A Long Road. Illegal operations are also useful for the other crime trophies: their guards are a good grouped target for Gunslinger, and their robberies feed the money and laundering totals. If you leave an operation unfinished, it comes back later, so nothing here is missable — and operations stay available after the credits, so you can finish the last few gangs in the post-story cleanup.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/9. One operation per gang, nine gangs; 100% needs all 39 operations: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach and this bronze trophy pops. The description is the whole method, and that is the honest limit of what is known at launch: no source has confirmed exactly which spot on Ocean Beach, which bar or vendor, or which interaction triggers it, so this guide does not invent one. What the description does tell you is the shape of the trophy: it is a moment, not a grind — go to Ocean Beach, find a place where you can have a cocktail with a view, and take the moment. The practical approach is to walk the beachfront, look for bars and cocktail spots with a view of the ocean, and try the interaction when you find one; if the first spot does not pop the trophy, try another spot along the beach rather than assuming the trophy is broken. It is one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch, alongside Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There and Ten Pin, and the launch-day guide says plainly that some of them may pop while you play normally. That is the best advice for this one too: visit Ocean Beach, enjoy the view, and let the trophy come to you — and if it has not popped by the post-story cleanup, make a dedicated trip along the beachfront and try each cocktail spot in turn.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. No confirmed unlock method at launch: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026 — the description is the only hint, and no location is claimed here.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style and this bronze trophy pops. The description is a reference to a classic Grand Theft Auto moment — driving a car straight through a showroom window — and that is the shape of the trophy, but no source has confirmed exactly which showroom, which vehicle, or which window triggers it at launch, so this guide does not invent one. The practical approach is the one the description suggests: find a vehicle showroom, get into a car inside it, and drive out through the glass in the most direct, classic way possible, rather than reversing out politely or leaving through the door. If the first showroom does not pop the trophy, try another one, and try it with a faster or heavier vehicle, because the trigger may be about speed, damage or the specific showroom rather than the act alone. It is one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch, and the launch-day guide says plainly that some of them may pop while you play normally — so do not grind this one in isolation. Visit showrooms when you are buying or browsing cars anyway, try the classic exit when the chance comes up, and let the trophy come to you in the course of normal play.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. No confirmed unlock method at launch: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026 — the description is the only hint, and no showroom is claimed here.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and this bronze trophy pops. The bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2, and the trophy is tied to robbing it properly rather than just playing a game of bowling there. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. The order matters: get the valuables first, blow the safe, and only then leave, because leaving something behind is the mistake that costs you the attempt — although if you do leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable, and you can try again. This is the one trophy where the launch-day checklist specifically suggests doing the job in Chapter 2, when you first visit the alley, rather than leaving it for the post-story cleanup — so do it when the alley is in front of you, with Sticky Bombs in your inventory. It also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, and as one of the 39 illegal operations for the 100% checklist, so it pulls triple duty when you do it right.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2; Sticky Bombs; luxury watch, shotgun, office safe; operation returns if valuables are left: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach a partnership with mass appeal and this bronze trophy pops — and the honest version of this guide is that the method is reported, not confirmed. The launch-day guide reports that it should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength: buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. That is the method to try first, and it is a sensible one, because the description is about a partnership and the gym is the one activity where the two characters train together. The practical way to do it is to buy the membership, train regularly with your partner along, and watch both characters' Strength climb — do not expect it to pop after a single session, because maximum Strength is a grind, and the trophy is about both characters reaching it, not just one. If it has not popped by the time both characters are at maximum Strength, the method may be wrong, and this guide will say so when a source confirms a different one — for now, the gym is the best lead anyone has, and it is the lead the launch-day guide gives. Nothing here is missable, and the gym stays open after the credits, so train a little every session and let the Strength build up.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. Reported method — both characters at maximum Strength, gym membership, train with your partner — not confirmed: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that change your Criminal Profile and this bronze trophy pops. PlayStation tracks it as 0/500, so you can see exactly how far along you are. The number sounds large, but the trophy is designed to fill up without a separate grind: robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up while you play normally, and by the time you have done the crime trophies, the side stories and the free-roam grind, the counter will be well on its way. The practical advice is not to grind it at all at first — just play, rob, fight, and check the counter every few sessions to see where you stand. If you reach the post-story cleanup and the counter is still short, the fix is to do more of what feeds it: robberies, illegal operations and fights, rather than quiet activities, because those are the actions that change a Criminal Profile. It is a background trophy, not a foreground one, and treating it as one is the fastest way to earn it: the 500 actions are the sum of a whole playthrough's worth of crime, not a single session's work. Nothing here is missable, and the counter keeps counting after the credits.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/500. 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile; robberies and fights feed it: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try and this bronze trophy pops — or at least, that is what the description suggests, and the honest limit of what is known at launch is that no source has confirmed the exact trigger. Second time's the charm is a hint, not a method: it could be about retrying a failed mission, a failed activity, a failed race or a failed robbery and succeeding on the second attempt, but no source has pinned down which one, or whether any second attempt counts. The practical approach is to play normally and let it come to you: you will fail things in the course of a 200-hour platinum — missions, races, challenges — and every retry is a chance for this trophy to pop. Do not deliberately fail things just to retry them, because that wastes time and the trigger may not be that simple; just play, retry the things you fail, and check whether it pops. It is one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch, and the launch-day guide says plainly that some of them may pop while you play normally. That is the best advice for this one: keep playing, keep retrying, and let the second try be the charm when it happens.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. No confirmed unlock method at launch: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026 — the description is the only hint, and no trigger is claimed here.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange and this bronze trophy pops — or at least, that is what the description suggests, and the honest limit of what is known at launch is that no source has confirmed what the strange thing is. What the hell just happened? is the reaction the trophy is named for, and it points at one of Leonida's odd moments: a strange event, a weird encounter, an easter egg in the world that you stumble across rather than seek out. The practical approach is to explore widely and pay attention: visit the odd corners of the map, the places that look like they are hiding something, the landmarks and the out-of-the-way spots, and when something strange happens, the trophy may pop. Do not grind this one in isolation, because there is no confirmed place to grind it at — the launch-day guide lists it among the five hidden trophies with no confirmed unlock method, and says plainly that some of them may pop while you play normally. That is the best advice here too: play the game, explore the state for The Goodtime State, collect cards and scan vehicles as you go, and let the strange moment find you. If it has not popped by the post-story cleanup, make a tour of Leonida's oddest places and see what is out there.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. No confirmed unlock method at launch: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026 — the description is the only hint, and no event or location is claimed here.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by and this bronze trophy pops — or at least, that is what the description suggests, and the honest limit of what is known at launch is that no source has confirmed the exact trigger. A melee drive-by means attacking someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, and Ten Pin — ten pin bowling — suggests knocking someone down the way a bowling ball knocks down pins, so the shape of the trophy is a drive-by melee hit that sends someone flying. The practical approach is to try it when the chance comes up in normal play: get into a vehicle, equip a melee weapon, drive past a pedestrian or an enemy at speed, and swing as you pass. If it does not pop, try it at different speeds, with different melee weapons, and against different targets, because the trigger may be about the knockdown rather than the hit. It is one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch, and the launch-day guide says plainly that some of them may pop while you play normally — so do not grind this one in isolation. Play, drive, and let the melee drive-by happen when it happens, and if it has not popped by the cleanup, make a dedicated attempt with a fast car and a clear road.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. No confirmed unlock method at launch: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026 — the description is the only hint, and no exact trigger is claimed here.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts and this bronze trophy pops. PlayStation tracks it as 0/250000, and the total is cumulative — you do not need $250,000 in one go, you need $250,000 in total across the whole run. Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs, so the way to earn them is to do those jobs: rob the vaults for Maximum Withdrawal, rob the payday loan jobs when they appear, and collect the marked bills they pay out. Then launder them by selling them to your contacts — the contacts are the laundering route, and the money you earn from selling the bills is what counts toward the $250,000. The practical approach is to launder as you go rather than stockpiling bills: sell them whenever you have a batch, and the total will climb alongside the robbery trophies. It pairs with the other money trophies — Treat Yo Self, which needs $100,000 spent across all shops, and Little Boxes, which needs eight garages bought for about $160,000 together — so the money you earn from laundering is the money you spend on the other two. Nothing here is missable, and bank and payday loan jobs stay available after the credits, so keep robbing, keep laundering, and let the total climb.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/250000. Marked Bills from bank and payday loan jobs, laundered by selling to contacts; total is cumulative: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops and this bronze trophy pops. PlayStation tracks it as 0/100000, and the total is cumulative across every kind of shop — clothes, weapons, food, car parts, anything you buy in a shop counts, so you do not need to spend it all in one place or on one thing. The practical way to earn it is to spend normally and let the total climb: buy the weapons and ammo you need for missions, buy the clothes and gear you want, upgrade your vehicles, and the $100,000 will arrive as a side effect of playing the game properly. If you reach the late game and the total is still short, the fix is to spend deliberately on the things you will actually use — a better weapon, a vehicle upgrade, a wardrobe refresh — rather than buying things just to hit the number, because the money is better spent on gear that helps the rest of the list. It pairs with the other money trophies: the cash comes from the heists and the laundering in Dime on the Dollar, and the garages in Little Boxes cost about $160,000 together, which is more than this trophy needs on its own. Nothing here is missable, and shops stay open after the credits, so spend as you go and let the total climb.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/100000. $100,000 cumulative across every kind of shop: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties and this bronze trophy pops. There are eight garages to buy, tracked by PlayStation as 0/8, and together they cost about $160,000 — so this is a money trophy as much as a property trophy, and the cash for it comes from the heists, the robberies and the laundering in Dime on the Dollar. Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, so do not look for them before that mission — the app is not open yet. Garages the story gives you do not count, so you need to buy all eight yourself, even if the story has already given you a place to park. The practical order is to buy garages early, as soon as you can afford them, because they are also what On the Spot needs: each car you register to the Scooter Bros app needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars, rather than trying to register cars with nowhere to put them. If money is tight, do the heists and the vault jobs first, launder the marked bills, and then buy the garages in a batch — the app will show you which ones you own and which ones are left. Nothing here is missable, and the real estate app stays open after the credits.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/8. Eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, unlocks after Daily Driver (Chapter 2), about $160,000 together; story-given garages do not count: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app and this bronze trophy pops. PlayStation tracks it as 0/10, and the method the launch-day guide gives is a chain: the Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app, so do not look for it before that mission. Once it is open, take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register — that is the registration flow, and each car you register counts toward the ten. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray, which is faster once it is available, because you do not need to go to Moses every time. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars — that is the practical order, and it is why Little Boxes comes before this trophy in the roadmap: eight garages give you the spaces you need, and cheap stolen cars are the easiest registrations, because you do not need to buy the car, just steal it, respray it and register it. If a registration does not count, check that the car is actually in a garage space and that the respray step is done, because the flow is Respray then Register, in that order. Nothing here is missable, and the app stays open after the credits.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles. PSN target 0/10. Scooter Bros app opens with Moses (Chapter 2); Respray then Register at Moses; standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray from Chapter 3; each car needs a free garage space: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
